comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop; PR-1896 measures tyre pressure and returns a pencil gauge.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests coupled screw/jam-nut counterholding; PR-1896 tests coaxial valve sealing, sustained pressing, and careful gauge replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades retained opening and lock integrity after cycling; PR-1896 grades a 33–37 psi reading after a sealed hold and gauge replacement.
comparison.reason: PR-1896 neither preserves an adjustable setting during locknut tightening nor verifies articulated motion.
